title: College World Series
metaDescription: College World Series 2027 in Omaha: dates, venue, travel basics and future MCWS dates from the NCAA schedule.

overview.about: The College World Series is the climax of American college baseball - a double-elimination tournament held each June at Charles Schwab Field in Omaha, Nebraska, where eight teams battle for the national championship. It is a major event on the US sporting calendar and a showcase for future Major League talent. USC's twelve titles are the most of any program. The 2027 series is on 18-28 June.
overview.nextEvent: The 2027 College World Series runs 18-28 June in Omaha. Eight teams that survive the NCAA tournament meet in a double-elimination format, with the championship decided by a best-of-three final series.

arrivalWindow: Arrive by 17 June 2027 if you want a buffer before open practice and the first game at Charles Schwab Field Omaha.
flightTip: For College World Series travel, compare Omaha flights first and keep Kansas City only as a backup if fares or connections make it worthwhile.
stayGuidance: Downtown Omaha and Old Market are practical bases for walking, food and ballpark access during the College World Series.
bookingAdvice: Book refundable rooms where possible; NCAA lists the 2027 championship series as 26-28 June, with the final date if necessary.
transportTip: Stay close to the ballpark if you can
transportDetail: Charles Schwab Field Omaha sits near downtown; staying nearby reduces parking and transfer friction during game days.
eventDayDetail: The College World Series can mean several game days in a row, so keep accommodation and return travel flexible until the final schedule is confirmed.
nextEditionDetail: 2027: 18-28 June at Charles Schwab Field Omaha. NCAA also lists 2028: 16-26 June and 2029: 15-25 June at the same Omaha venue.
entryDetail: Use NCAA and CWS Omaha ticket channels for current sale windows, hospitality options and game-day policies.

@graph.description: The College World Series decides the NCAA Division I baseball champion each June at Charles Schwab Field in Omaha, which the city has hosted since 1950. A best-of-three final caps the double-elimination bracket and makes Omaha the centre of the American college baseball summer.
